mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, code, title, phase, priority, status, created_at FROM test_case WHERE project_id IN #{pid} AND (lower(code) LIKE '%' || lower(#{q}) || '%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(#{q}) || '%') ORDER BY code LIMIT 15
